STR_DOWNGRADE:
Make sure Anda have cadangan dari stock sFlash dump dan SYSCON.

 Slot switching adalah used for FW revert (downgrade).
 Revert can fix "loadbios" kesalahan, if cadangan slot adalah not corrupted.

 Mulai with most relevant pattern, if it doesn't help try others.
 Gunakan UART ke track changes in "release_branches/release_xx" line.

 After finding right switch pattern patch syscon,
 otherwise Anda'll get "checkUpdVersion" kesalahan.

STR_INFO_CODEREADER:
PS4 errlog [0-3F] command serves ke get kesalahan's kode.
 Make first read then bersihkan dan reboot ke get actual kode.
 Log ke file adalah enabled - Anda will not miss anything.

 Bantuan ke improve - report Anda kode here:
STR_INFO_EAPKEYS:
Eap kunci may be 0x40 dan 0x60 byte length
 PS4 10xx/11xx models usually have only one kunci
 And 12xx/Slim/PRO models have cadangan kunci
STR_INFO_EMC_CFW:
Gunakan at Anda own risk!
 Only for Aeolia (PS4 Fat 10xx/11xx)
 Grants control over itu southbridge dan syscon

 Additional info:

These kunci allow Anda ke explore PS4 HDD file with PC

STR_INFO_LEG_PATCH:
This method adalah only suitable for working consoles!
 Because it requires updating via PS4 safe menu

 1) Baca first dump (if Anda've not done it already)
 2) Update itu console ONCE (ke obtain second switch pattern)
 3) Baca second dump (both slots have equal FW)

 Now Anda can patch first dump with data dari second one
 You can drag&drop 2 dumps on wee-alat shortcut ke speed up
STR_INFO_NVS:
Swaps corrupted blok dengan cadangan data (not suitable for 10xx/11xx)
 Peringatan - UART dan other flags may be overwritten.
 If Anda need ke set some flags do it after NVS recovery!
STR_INFO_PART_A_R:
Compares every byte dari (SFlash/Syscon) partition with valid file
 dan shows percentage dari similarity.
 Most equal file will be at top dari itu list.
 Keep in mind that Southbridge FW consists dari emc + eap
STR_INFO_REGENERATE:
This tool regenerates NVS areas dari dump with help dari donor dump
 Can fix: Reset loop / Tidak power / 3 beeps / some other
 it adalah recommended ke use dumps with equal Board ID dan
 donor dump should have higher or same FW
STR_INFO_RL78FLASH:
In order ke write baru blank syscon chip (Renesas RL78G10)
 Anda need USB ke TTL adapter, wires dan some diodes.

 2xxx 7xxx (Slim/Pro) R5F10*LL*FB 64-pin LFQFP (10×10mm, 0.5mm)
 R5F100LLAFB, R5F100LLDFB, R5F101LLAFB, R5F101LLDFB

 1xxx (Phat) R5F10*PL*FB 100-pin LFQFP (14×14mm, 0.5mm)
 R5F100PLAFB, R5F100PLDFB, R5F101PLAFB, R5F101PLDFB

 Wiring diagram can be ditemukan in assets/hw/l78flash folder
STR_INFO_SB_PATCH:
Will be useful in case dari:
 - corrupted Southbridge FW or "EMC VERSION DOWN" errors
 - switching ke lain IC module (CXD90046 => CXD90036)
 - replacement dari APU bundles (21xx => 22xx, 71xx => 72xx)
STR_INFO_SCF:
Syscon Flasher allows Anda ke r/w asli PS4 syscon chip (RL78/G13)
 Flasher supports only A0x-COLx syscon models
 Currently hardware part adalah based on Teensy boards (2.0++/4.0/4.1)
 Look at </assets/hw/syscon_flasher> for diagrams dan Teensy's FW
 More info here:
STR_INFO_SC_BOOTMODES:
Boot mode rekaman adalah encrypted, so we can't detect its purpose
 You should try each dari them by yourself ke determine what adalah it for
 These rekaman serve ke enable/disable FSM (Factory Service Mode)
 Keep in mind: some rekaman may have duplicates (marked with color)
STR_INFO_SC_GLITCH:
Pembaca Syscon oleh DarkNESmonk (Arduino Nano V3 CH340)
Lihat folder </assets/hw/syscon_reader> untuk informasi selengkapnya
STR_INFO_SC_MPATCH:
Every rekaman has 16 byte length. First byte adalah always "A5"
 The second byte adalah rekaman "jenis" usually in range [0x00-0x30]
 Firmware update takes 4 rekaman with types %s
 To cancel last fw update we need ke bersihkan these 4 rekaman (fill 0xFF)
 If there adalah %s,%s types after %s patch adalah impossible
 cadangan slot adalah already overwritten, Anda'll got checkUpdVersion kesalahan
STR_INFO_SC_REBUILDER:
This util will help Anda ke create custom version dari Syscon.
 Can fix: SU-39176-6, CE-40947-4, Corrupt Syscon, GET_HDMI_STATE,
 Wake Invalid kesalahan, PSN Activation, leave FSM dan some other.
 You can adjust each jenis dari rekaman in expert mode.
 Entries adalah sorted dari saat ini ke past.
 * To select previous FW Anda need ke masukkan "2" or more.
 * Minimal setup consists dari 3 types (00-03 + 04-07 + 08-0B)
STR_INFO_SPIWAY:
SPIway - sflash r/w with random blok access support (Teensy++ 2.0)
 Look at </assets/hw/spiway> folder for diagrams dan Teensy's FW
 More info at PSDevWiki:
STR_INFO_TORUS_PATCH:
Will be useful in case dari:
 - corrupted Torus (WiFi+BT) FW
 - switching ke lain IC module

 DS4 works in safe mode (wired), but in normal mode it doesn't work
 (wired/wireless) -> no power on itu BT module or BT adalah faulty.

STR_OVERCLOCKING:
Operasi berbahaya!

 Most GDDR5 runs at 6000-8000 MHz. GDDR5 adalah quad pumped [x4]
 GDDR5 at 8000 MHz technically runs at 2000 MHz
 If Anda have problems, decrease frequency ke 1000 MHz

 Effective GDDR5 clock adalah 1350 MHz
 The frequency adalah dipilih experimentally
 - Too high value can lead ke LOADBIOS -8 or DCT [*] kesalahan
 - Too low value leads ke AMDINIT kesalahan
